title: Component acceptance from mixture acceptance
statement: Let $n>0$, let $L$ be a finite system of homogeneous quadratic equations over $\mathbb{F}_2$, let $\varepsilon\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $w$ and $\pi$ be Boolean words of lengths $n$ and $2^n+2^{n^2}$, respectively. If the verifier for the associated proof system accepts $(w,\pi)$ with probability at least $1-\varepsilon/100000$, then each of its three component testers accepts $(w,\pi)$ with probability at least $1-(3/100000)\varepsilon$.
